lines.text: - Turning off **Upload and link** lasts only until the next launch, because `toggle_listener` stores nothing and `main.c` calls `shell_start_listener` on every start.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: add vitadeck-144, a case for misses from unread files
lines.text: - `lan_listener_start` reads the address once and `lan_address_detect` falls back to `127.0.0.1`, so the Shell can show a loopback address until the listener restarts.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: add vitadeck-144, a case for misses from unread files
lines.text: - A failed Deck App Storage replace now says `Could not write Deck App Storage.`, and the old `Could not replace Deck App Storage.` text is gone, because `deck_app_storage.c` now calls `vd_replace_file`.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: add vitadeck-144, a case for misses from unread files
lines.text: - `vd_replace_file` and `vd_read_replaced_file` in `src/core/util.c` are the temp and backup file replace moved from `deck_app_storage.c`, and the link store in `link.c` now uses them too.

lines.author: Máté Molnár

lines.text: - `withPublishedVersions` in `copy-templates.ts` rewrites workspace versions in every template `package.json`, not only the scaffold's.

lines.author: Máté Molnár

lines.text: - Cross on the Host Control screen forgets the focused computer at once, with no confirm step.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: add vitadeck-144, a case for misses from unread files
lines.text: - The lines removed from `package_manifest.c` are `skip_json_value`, moved to `json.c` as `json_skip_value` with the same body.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: add vitadeck-144, a case for misses from unread files
lines.text: - `createEventLog` drops the oldest event past 100 per plugin, and `wait` returns no sign of the gap, so a slow watcher loses events with no signal.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: add vitadeck-144, a case for misses from unread files
lines.text: - `cpuPercent` keeps one module-level `previous` sample, so two Vitas each read the CPU share since the other's read.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: add vitadeck-144, a case for misses from unread files
lines.text: - `config.vitas` stores the Vita's IP from `route`, and `isAllowed` compares the peer to that list, so a linked Vita that gets a new address receives 403.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: add vitadeck-144, a case for misses from unread files
lines.text: - `lan_address_detect` on POSIX takes the first IPv4 interface that does not start with `127.`, so a host with a VPN or container network can show the wrong address.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: add vitadeck-144, a case for misses from unread files
lines.text: - A document `lookFor` bullet says the PR body claims only read-only built-ins exist, while `core.notify` emits an event that any Deck App can watch.

lines.text: - Do not write a file note that says a file or hunk was not fetched, not read, or unverified, or that gives only a line count such as "Adds 71 lines".

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: add vitadeck-144, a case for misses from unread files
lines.text: - Do not say `util.c` adds string or parsing helpers, or that `deck_app_storage.c` drops parsing helpers; the moved code replaces files.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: add vitadeck-144, a case for misses from unread files
lines.text: - Do not say `bootstrap.c` starts the listener or that `main.c` starts the link store; `bootstrap.c` calls `host_control_links_init`, and `main.c` calls `shell_start_listener`.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: add vitadeck-144, a case for misses from unread files
lines.text: - Do not say that turning off **Upload and link** persists across launches.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: add vitadeck-144, a case for misses from unread files
lines.text: - Do not describe the removal in `package_manifest.c` as a change in manifest parsing; the helper moved with no change in behavior.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: add vitadeck-144, a case for misses from unread files
lines.text: - Do not repeat the PR claim that only read-only built-ins exist as a fact; `core.notify` is a built-in that emits an event.

lines.text: ## Notes

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: add vitadeck-144, a case for misses from unread files

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: add vitadeck-144, a case for misses from unread files
lines.text: - Why this case exists: the skill used to allow eight fetches on a change past six files. Seven reviews written under that cap (Haiku medium and high, Sonnet low and high, Opus low and high, Grok low, skill 0.13.2) stated each `Must` at most three times, and most once or never. A file with no fetch got a note like "Host implementation." or "One added line; hunk not fetched."

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: add vitadeck-144, a case for misses from unread files
lines.text: - Blind grades with this list, one run each: Opus 5.5 high went from `must` 2/6 to 6/6 after the cap was removed, and Haiku 5.5 high from 1/6 to 3/6. The `Must` items came from what capped runs missed, so read the gain together with the false claims a grader finds, which this list did not choose.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: add vitadeck-144, a case for misses from unread files
lines.text: - The eval grader on Opus 5.5 high, one run each: `must` 2/6 under the cap and 5/6 after it. A `sources FAIL` on these runs only means the review cited a source that is not frozen here, because they fetched sources live.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: add vitadeck-144, a case for misses from unread files
lines.text: - Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor, two trials each with the eval grader: `must` stayed at 1/6 or 2/6 after the cap went, while false bullets fell from 14 of 242 to 4 of 243 and files read rose from 8 to all 109. Its file notes average under seven words, so facts it read stay out of the review. A case line near 2/6 on this model does not mean the producer read too little.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: add vitadeck-144, a case for misses from unread files
lines.text: - Each `Must not` about a file note comes from one of those reviews. Sonnet low swapped `main.c` and `bootstrap.c`. Grok low called the file replace helpers string and parsing helpers. Opus high wrote 21 notes that said "not fetched".

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: add vitadeck-144, a case for misses from unread files
lines.text: - Each `Must` sits in a file that no PR text describes and whose digest line gives only symbols or a line count. A review states it only when it read the hunk. The PR body and `#109` to `#111` state the other design facts, which is why those are not here.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: add vitadeck-144, a case for misses from unread files
lines.text: - The `Good` list holds facts that need a second file or a trace across files, per `eval/review-criteria.md`.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: add vitadeck-144, a case for misses from unread files
lines.text: - `Must` and `Must not` scores do not change the exit code. Read the case line, for example `must 1/6  mustNot 2/6`, and compare it with a run of the older skill.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: add vitadeck-144, a case for misses from unread files
lines.text: - `together` holds file pairs that every past run kept in one group. `apart` holds layers that every past run split. There is no `mechanicalPaths` expect, because past runs did not agree on where the lockfile goes.
